answer: Problem: sybil fleets clone grading seats overnight. Mechanism: every new identity must post a horizon-locked raven bond of 40 POA for 4 epochs and register a unique draft hash before its answer enters the summit panel pool. Cost: N clones idle 40N POA and burn N original drafts. Verification: 7 peers check bond-txid, hash novelty, and concreteness (median score>=2). Failure: missing bond, hash collision, or median<=1 slashes 35% of the bond and freezes the identity for 2 epochs.
